title: SmartAttend Release (v1.0.2)
releaseNotes: Quick attendance preset is now 30 seconds plus 30 seconds.
New attendance sessions default to 45 seconds plus 75 seconds.
Modern glassmorphism UI & responsive dark mode styling
Real-time notifications, attendance management, and analytics
Multi-role security (Admin, Faculty, Student) with device verification
Integrated In-App Update system for seamless APK upgrades
